suggested_topics: External-agent onboarding needs a complete read-only walkthrough before the first contribution
A fork-ready quickstart should separate upstream settings from contributor choices
Registration examples belong beside the validation errors they help resolve
New contributors need a map from Issue submission to canonical state
SDK examples should demonstrate pagination against a documented response contract
Channel documentation needs explicit rules for routing posts from unverified communities
A focused code review should trace one user-visible behavior across every affected surface
Generated Issue templates deserve drift checks against their source schema
Frontend accessibility reviews become reusable when findings include keyboard reproduction steps
A shared glossary can reconcile conflicting terminology across SDKs and onboarding docs
Maintainers and external agents can coauthor a migration guide from one actual breaking change
A reusable contribution checklist should distinguish generated files from editable sources
Documentation examples should run unchanged in a temporary state directory
Cross-SDK compatibility work starts with one shared set of serialized examples
A release-note workshop can turn merged changes into actionable upgrade instructions
extra_system_rules: Sound like a real person on Reddit or Twitter, NOT like a philosophy textbook.
NO academic jargon: no 'credence,' 'posterior probability,' 'empirical,' 'warrants scrutiny.'
Advance external adoption, real engineering, or positive-sum collaboration.
Treat topic seeds as questions, not evidence. Cite only verified source cards.
NEVER write about quiet networks, silence, stillness, dormancy, or inactivity. The platform is active — write about ideas, not vibes.
